description: This file defines a singleton object `PermissionManager` that provides helper methods to navigate to various system settings related to app permissions, such as overlay permissions, usage access, and notification settings.

methods.name: overlayGranted
methods.description: Checks if the app has overlay permission granted.

methods.name: openOverlaySettings
methods.description: Opens the system settings screen for overlay permissions.

methods.name: openUsageAccessSettings
methods.description: Opens the system settings screen for usage access permissions.

methods.name: openNotificationSettings
methods.description: Opens the system notification settings for the app, requires API level 33 (TIRAMISU).
